sentences.en: Let's keep in mind!
Shall we go?
Where shall we go? I haven't got a car.
Here's your passport.

sentences.fa: چيزي هم براي اظهار کردن داري؟
sentences.en: Have you got anything to declare?
What have you got to declare?

sentences.fa: مي شه اون کت و شلوار پشت ويترين رو بهم نشون بدي؟
sentences.en: Could you show me that suit on the window?
Which one shall I show you?

sentences.fa: اوه خداي من! اينجا رو ببين، کلي چيز داري.
sentences.en: Oh dear look at this, you have got a lot of things.

sentences.fa: چندتا چمدون سنگين دارم، مي شه برام تاکسي بگيري؟
sentences.en: I have got some heavy luggage, could you take a taxi for me?
Have you got a map?

sentences.fa: نقشه ندارم، مي شه من رو تا موزه ببري؟
sentences.en: I haven't got a map, could you take me to the museum?
My mother hasn't got address, what shall we do?
Shall I ask her the address?
Have you got anything to eat?

sentences.fa: چيزي براي خوردن ندارم، براي شام بريم بيرون؟
sentences.en: I haven't got anything to eat; shall we go out for dinner?

sentences.fa: اوه خداي من! اين خيلي گرونه، مي شه بهم تخفيف بديد؟
sentences.en: Oh dear! It is very expensive; could you give me a discount?

sentences.fa: صاحب مغازه نيستم، مي شه باهام چونه نزنيد.
sentences.en: I am not a shop owner; could you not bargain with me?

sentences.fa: مي شه صورتحساب رو برام بياري ؟
sentences.en: Could you bring me the bill?
Shall I bring you the bill?
Have you got prohibited objects?
Would you like to smoke a shisha or cigarette?

sentences.fa: سيگار داري؟ مي خوام يه پک به سيگارت بزنم.
sentences.en: Have you got any cigarette? I would like to take a drag at your cigarette.

sentences.fa: مي شه دستبند پشت ويترين رو بهم نشون بدي؟
sentences.en: Could you show me that bracelet on the window?

sentences.fa: اين مدل رو ندارم، يکي ديگه رو نشونت بدم؟
sentences.en: I haven't got this model; shall I show you another one?

sentences.fa: اوه خداي من! اينجا رو ببين.
sentences.en: Oh dear! Look at this.
You haven't got a passport.

sentences.fa: برعکس، همه چي دارم، زندگي محشره.
sentences.en: On the contrary; I have got everything; life is great.

sentences.fa: در خدمتم، چيکار مي تونم برات بکنم؟
sentences.en: I am at your service, what can I do for you?

sentences.fa: امري ديگه با من داري، برم؟
sentences.en: Any things else with me, shall I go?

sentences.fa: بعنوان غذاي اصلي چي مي خواهي؟
sentences.en: What would you like as a main course?
Have you got any sea food?

sentences.fa: مي شه غذاي دريايي برای من سفارش ندي؟
sentences.en: Could you not order sea food for me?
What shall I order for you?
Could you show it to me?
Have you got any baggage?

sentences.fa: توی صندوق هست، مي شه برام بگيريش؟
sentences.en: It is in the trunk, could you get it for me?

sentences.fa: جاي خالي رو ميز نيست، کجا بزارمش؟
sentences.en: There isn't any space on the table, where shall I put it?
Life is terrible!
I am broke.
Have you got anything to show?
I have got some questions, when shall I ask you?

sentences.fa: شروع کنيم، شروع کنيم، سؤالي داري؟ سؤالي ندارم، شروع کنيم.
sentences.en: Shall we start? Let's start, have you got any questions? I haven't got any questions, let's start.
